placement.source: modelling_assumption: boat stern 0.1 m forward of the EXO rear deck plate edge (x = 2.2 m), centred between the float rows; stern/aft cabin under the frame bays, bow 5.15 m beyond the end frame. Vertical position and attitude come from the boat's own flotation, never from this transform.

proxy_hull_at_drawn_waterline.note: mass the proxy hull would need to float at the package's z=0 waterline; compare with the 2.1-3.0 t references -> hull form/datum consistency check

illustrative/with_hydronaute.lines_note: coupled static equilibrium (buoyancy + weight + tension-only lines): boat shifted 7 mm x, 0 mm y, -0.01 deg yaw from the nominal berth; line tensions LINE_AFT_PORT 88 N, LINE_AFT_STBD 87 N, SPRING_PORT 44 N, SPRING_STBD 43 N; residual 7.6e-12 of Mg

coupled_equilibrium.note: Coupled static equilibrium: buoyancy + weight + tension-only line springs on both bodies; the EXO fixes the horizontal frame, the boat shifts/yaws until the line forces balance. L0 = L_nominal - T0/k.

lateral_clearance_to_float_inner_face_m.note: boat topsides at the station half-beam vs the float proxy inner face, over the overlapping x-range

illustrative/with_hydronaute.combined_note: Combined system = two bodies with assumed mass distributions, a proxy boat hull and an assumed berth position. No combined-vessel capacity, limit or approval follows from it.
